company.name: Probably Genetic
company.shortDescription: Probably Genetic is changing the lives of patients living with severe, complex diseases.
company.description: Probably Genetic is changing the lives of patients living with severe, complex diseases. Our technology discovers patients online, analyzes their disease state using AI and at-home testing, and connects patients to relevant resources. In doing so, we help patients access diagnoses, interventions, and resources as early as possible. Our data platform is used by drug developers and patient advocacy groups to develop and launch treatments for these patients.

productsAndServices.description: A patient-initiated program offering free clinical-grade genetic testing for over 4,000 rare diseases via at-home saliva or cheek swab samples.

productsAndServices.description: A free, at-home genetic test for individuals in the US with symptoms suggestive of frontotemporal dementia, including genetic counseling and physician-ordered testing.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $10,719,968, or 98.62% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,963,537 to $73,745,501, a 24.88x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
